title: RetractSameAs
description: Withdraws a previously asserted equivalence. Emitted when an operator records a :NOT_SAME_AS correction against a SAME_AS that turned out to be wrong. The Virtuoso sink removes the <a> owl:sameAs <b> triple (both directions) from the entity-type graph; the Neo4j sink deletes the SAME_AS edge and writes the NOT_SAME_AS edge so the consolidator's rules will not re-propose the pair. A retraction is not a candidate decision: declining a proposal never asserted anything and so needs no retraction.

reason.description: Why the assertion was wrong. Free text from the operator.

retracted_method.description: The method/rule that had produced the withdrawn assertion, carried for analysis of which rules misfire.
